ingredients: 3/4 kg (1.5 lbs) chicken thighs or legs (skinless)
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste (or ~3/4 tbsp each grated)
1–2 tsp Kashmiri red chili powder (or paprika; adjust heat)
1/2 tsp sea salt (plus more to adjust)
1 tbsp lemon juice (or 1 tsp amchur / dried mango powder; or 1/2 tsp chaat masala)
1 1/2 tbsp oil (neutral oil; or mustard oil)
1–2 tbsp oil (or use melted butter instead)
Marinade should be thick (not runny) so it clings to the chicken.
Best with full-fat strained yogurt / Greek yogurt.
Timing varies by oven and chicken size; adjust as needed.

steps: Make marinade: In a bowl, mix yogurt, ginger garlic paste, garam masala, red chili powder, salt, turmeric, kasuri methi, black pepper, coriander powder, cumin powder, oil, and lemon juice (or chaat masala). Taste and adjust salt/spice.
Prep chicken: Pat chicken dry. Make deep slits (3–4 on large pieces; 2–3 on smaller).
Marinate: Add chicken to marinade and coat well. Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours (or overnight).
Roast: Place a wire rack on a foil-lined tray; grease/spray rack. Arrange chicken on rack. Roast 25–30 min total, basting with leftover marinade or chili oil/melted butter after the first 12–15 min.
Flip + finish: Turn chicken after basting and roast another 12–15 min. Move tray to top rack and broil 3–4 min for charred spots.
Check doneness: Internal temp should read 165–170°F (75°C).
Serve: Brush with drippings/butter to keep moist. Garnish with chopped coriander. Serve with chutney, onion + lemon wedges.
notes: Swasthi’s Recipes – Tandoori Chicken Recipe (Smoky Restaurant Style)
